conclusions.text: All 207 source-level output claims now equal the actual pinned administrative_level metadata values: 185 ADM2 claims and 22 Named physical region portion claims. These strings faithfully reproduce source metadata and do not establish legal status or geographic suitability.
The 185 direct features and 22 overlays have exact source identity/member joins within retained source records, while the original territorial and completeness dispositions remain unresolved.

The 2017 ADM2 source does not establish current legal roles, complete Russia membership, island coverage or acceptable Atlas simplification; federal-subject boundaries and complete child membership are also unresolved.
The 21 ecoregion fragments and Lake Baikal fragment remain non-administrative overlays with unresolved parent, water/gap and temporal semantics.
This erratum makes no legal geography, boundary, completeness, publication or historical-import approval.
